comment: Read by quality/public.mjs. Each id in ids goes on the public page with needs none, and its targets file's params take params below; every other entry that needs local files is dropped. repo_only (collectors/instructions/instructions.mjs) reads only the files the repo commits, so CI reads them too. AGENTS.md counts because CLAUDE.md imports it (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, read 2026-11-13). drop: Git Crafter metrics that cannot apply to this repo, written to quality/public/targets/repo-drops.json, never to targets/, which adopters load as the pack. security.claude_review_share counts only the Claude GitHub App's reviews, and this repo runs no paid review (#12); the lockfile, dependency and install-step ones read a package.json and an npm install this repo does not have. tools.adopters_latest_share and tools.latest_dependency_pr_ci_minutes need adopters and a merged dependency PR this repo does not have. params_for: this repo's params for a Git Crafter metric, as a repo override would set them.
